body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh government is set to harness the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to make social welfare schemes more effective, transparent, and free from irregularities. The state's Social Welfare Department is working towards technologically strengthening the monitoring of key welfare schemes such as old age pension, family benefit, scholarships, and mass marriages. This initiative aims not only to ensure that benefits reach the rightful beneficiaries but also to make administrative processes faster, paperless, and more accountable.AI-based monitoring system.
